posts.title: tmux for the agentic era (flagship thread)
posts.draftHook: tmux is great. But it was built for humans, not agents. rmux is the Rust, tmux-compatible multiplexer with a typed SDK, detach, reattach, and inspect long-lived agents from code. 7-tweet thread.

posts.title: I lost a 3-hour agent run to a dropped SSH
posts.draftHook: I lost a 3-hour agent run when my SSH dropped. So I started using rmux: persistent detachable sessions + a typed snapshot() of exactly what the agent did.

posts.title: SDK quickstart, drive a terminal from Rust
posts.draftHook: Driving a terminal from code used to mean scraping stdout and praying. rmux returns a typed PaneSnapshot and lets you wait_for_text() before reading. Here's the whole quickstart.

posts.title: Stop scraping capture-pane
posts.draftHook: Stop scraping `tmux capture-pane`. rmux gives you a typed PaneSnapshot, cols, rows, content, that doesn't break when output formatting changes.

posts.title: rmux vs tmux, compatible, not a compromise
posts.draftHook: r/rust: I built a tmux-compatible multiplexer in Rust (all 90 commands) with a typed SDK + daemon. Here's the 3-surface architecture and why. Your .tmux.conf migrates.

posts.title: tmux on Windows, finally
posts.draftHook: tmux on Windows? With rmux, natively, ConPTY + per-user Named Pipes, no WSL shim. All 90 tmux commands, your .tmux.conf migrates.

posts.title: Assert on a terminal like it's a DOM
posts.draftHook: What if you could test a TUI like a webpage? rmux: wait_for_text() + typed snapshots = deterministic terminal tests in CI. Playwright-for-terminal, built in.

posts.title: Three surfaces, one daemon
posts.draftHook: One local daemon. Three surfaces: the rmux CLI, the rmux-sdk crate, and the ratatui-rmux widget. Anything one can do, the others can too. Here's the architecture.

posts.title: forbid-unsafe, no network at runtime
posts.draftHook: A terminal multiplexer you can trust in infra: #![forbid(unsafe_code)] in the upper crates, no network at runtime (enforced by a build guardrail), locked builds, dual MIT/Apache.

posts.title: ratatui-rmux, a live terminal pane in your TUI
posts.draftHook: `cargo add ratatui-rmux` and drop a real, live terminal pane into your Ratatui app, backed by the typed SDK. ~6 lines to render. Ecosystem launch.
